description: cranker-llm's hooks. The read guard: in the folders listed under read_guard.roots in the worker's config, a whole-file Read of a big text file is sent to the local worker first (does nothing until folders are listed). The scale: a session that uses the worker and is below the local-to-Claude scale (scale.ratio, 5 by default; 0 turns it off) gets a note with its numbers and what real load to hand over, at most every 15 minutes. Neither blocks anything else.

hooks.command: PY=$(command -v py || command -v python3 || command -v python); "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/read_guard.py"
PY=$(command -v py || command -v python3 || command -v python); "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/local_share.py" --hook
PY=$(command -v py || command -v python3 || command -v python); "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/local_share.py" --hook
